headline: Anthropic demonstrates Claude accelerates drug development workflows
body: Anthropic published research showing Claude can expedite drug development processes, marking a significant milestone in applying large language models to pharmaceutical R&D. This matters for healthcare AI because drug discovery represents one of the highest-value use cases where AI can compress timelines and reduce costs in a heavily regulated industry. The capability suggests LLMs could optimize how biotech teams manage literature review, compound screening, and regulatory documentation, directly impacting time-to-market for therapies. For healthcare consulting firms advising pharma and biotech clients, this validates the business case for integrating advanced AI into discovery workflows rather than limiting deployment to back-office functions.
